svg.text: LINKS T10: 5 ROWS @ 100 FROM FACE, LEGS @ 100 ALONG THE FACE
ROWS X LINKS - T - SPACING (PER FACE)
1. ALL DIMENSIONS ARE IN MILLIMETRES, LEVELS IN METRES UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE. DO NOT SCALE; FOLLOW THE WRITTEN DIMENSIONS.
2. CONCRETE f'c = 35 MPa (drawing). REINFORCEMENT: DEFORMED BARS fy = 420 MPa (drawing). CLEAR COVER 25 mm TOP AND BOTTOM
3. SLAB THICKNESS 250 mm. THIS SHEET IS TO BE READ WITH THE CONSULTANT'S STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS (G.A.) AND THE PT LAYOUT;
DISCREPANCIES TO BE REFERRED TO THE ENGINEER BEFORE FABRICATION.
4. PRELIMINARY: PUNCHING LINKS ARE SHOWN AS THE MINIMUM DETAILING ARRANGEMENT (SBC 304-18 §8.7.6 / §22.6.8): T10 CLOSED LINKS,
FIRST ROW AT d/2 = 100 mm FROM THE COLUMN FACE, ROWS AT d/2, LEGS AT 100 mm ALONG THE FACE, EXTENDING 500 mm (2h) BEYOND THE FACE.
THE NUMBER OF ROWS AND LINK SIZE ARE TO BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE PUNCHING DESIGN (Vu) BEFORE FABRICATION.
5. CALL-OUT PER FACE: [ROWS] X [LINKS PER ROW] - T[Ø] - [ROW SPACING]. FACES AT A SLAB EDGE CARRY NO LINKS. LINKS ENCLOSE THE TOP
6. PS TYPES GROUP COLUMNS WITH THE SAME ARRANGEMENT (TABLE, DETAIL 2).
A1. PUNCHING SHEAR DEMAND (Vu) NOT AVAILABLE: LINK ROWS SET BY MINIMUM DETAILING AND 2h EXTENT; SUBJECT TO DESIGN CONFIRMATION.
A2. Bottom mesh not specified: T12@200 both ways assumed as bonded reinforcement in PT zones.
A3. Edge U-bars not specified: T12@150 with 1200 mm legs assumed at PT anchorage edges.
A4. Opening trimmers not specified: 2T16 T&B each side + 2T12 diagonals at corners assumed.
A5. Void trimmers not specified: 2T12 T&B each side assumed.
SBC 304-18 AS STATED ON THE STRUCTURAL DRAWINGS. DEVELOPMENT, ANCHORAGE AND LAP LENGTHS PER SBC 304-18 CHAPTER 25 (ACI 318-14
